items.name: text-field
items.title: TextField
items.description: Single-line text input on Base UI Input, composed with Field: label click focuses the input, description and error are linked with aria-describedby, invalid state shows an alert with an icon. Placeholder uses the fg-soft token for contrast.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Inspired by the YoRHa UI aesthetic; no original fonts, logos or assets are included. `clearable` adds a clear button inside an InputGroup (kept mounted, invisible while empty); `reserveError` keeps one error line reserved. Errors from `Form errors` now render under the field even without the `error` prop.
